You are evaluating a software engineering task for repository dask/dask.

Problem Statement:
DataFrame.join doesn't accept Series as other

**What happened**:
`dataframe.join(series)` throws `ValueError: other must be DataFrame`.

**What you expected to happen**:
The [document](https://docs.dask.org/en/latest/dataframe-api.html#dask.dataframe.DataFrame.join) states `join` accepts `Series` object as `other`. It seems `is_dataframe_like`, which called by `join`, checks if an object has `merge` attribute, but it doesn't work for `Series`.

https://github.com/dask/dask/blob/45fd9092049a61c1d43067a0132574b3fe715153/dask/utils.py#L1116-L1123

**Minimal Complete Verifiable Example**:

```python
>>> import dask.dataframe as dd
>>> df = dd.from_pandas(pd.DataFrame(range(10), columns=['a']), npartitions=1)
>>> df

>>> df['a']

ValueError: other must be DataFrame
```

entries.author: teacher
entries.content: Root cause: `DataFrame.join` in `dask/dataframe/core.py` validated `other` with only `is_dataframe_like`, which checks for a `merge` attribute that Series lack, so a Dask/pandas Series was rejected with `ValueError: other must be DataFrame`. The downstream `merge` in `dask/dataframe/multi.py` already handles Series on either side. Fix: also accept `is_series_like(other)` and update the error message to "other must be DataFrame or Series". Verified `df.join(df['a'].rename('b'))` matches pandas output and that invalid input still raises ValueError; the 4 failing `test_multi.py -k join` tests fail identically on the unpatched baseline (pre-existing pandas incompatibility).
